title: Asian Financial Crisis
description: Triggered by the collapse of the Thai Baht, leading to a regional currency and financial crisis across Asia.

title: Russian Financial Crisis
description: Russia defaults on its debt and devalues the ruble, causing global financial contagion.

title: LTCM Bailout
description: The Federal Reserve orchestrates a bailout of Long-Term Capital Management to prevent wider market collapse.

title: Dot-com Bubble Burst
description: The NASDAQ peaks and begins a multi-year collapse, destroying trillions in paper wealth.

title: Argentine Great Depression & Default
description: Argentina defaults on $93 billion of sovereign debt, the largest in history at the time.

title: BNP Paribas Freezes Funds
description: BNP Paribas suspends three investment funds due to subprime mortgage exposure, widely considered the start of the 2008 financial crisis.

title: Northern Rock Bank Run
description: The first major run on a British bank in 150 years as Northern Rock faces a liquidity crisis.

title: Bear Stearns Collapse
description: JPMorgan Chase acquires Bear Stearns in a fire sale backed by the Federal Reserve.

title: Lehman Brothers Bankruptcy
description: Lehman Brothers files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy, triggering a global financial meltdown.

title: Greek Bailout / European Debt Crisis
description: The EU and IMF agree to a €110 billion bailout package for Greece, escalating fears of sovereign defaults across the PIIGS nations.

title: US Debt Downgrade
description: S&P downgrades the US credit rating from AAA to AA+ following the debt ceiling crisis, driving gold to record highs.

title: Taper Tantrum
description: US Treasury yields surge as the Fed signals it will taper quantitative easing, causing heavy sell-offs in gold and emerging markets.

title: Chinese Stock Market Crash
description: A rapid plunge in the Shanghai Stock Exchange triggers global market volatility and commodity drops.

title: Brexit Vote & Pound Flash Crash
description: The UK votes to leave the EU, triggering a massive drop in the British Pound and a spike in gold prices.

title: Turkish Lira Crisis
description: The Turkish Lira collapses due to high inflation, current account deficits, and deteriorating relations with the US.

title: US Repo Market Crisis
description: Overnight repo rates spike up to 10%, forcing the Federal Reserve to intervene to provide market liquidity.

title: COVID-19 Market Crash
description: Global equity markets crash violently due to the outbreak of the COVID-19 pandemic, leading to aggressive monetary stimulus.

title: Evergrande Liquidity Crisis
description: Chinese real estate giant Evergrande misses bond interest payments, sparking fears of property sector contagion.

title: Terra/Luna Collapse
description: The TerraUSD algorithmic stablecoin loses its peg, wiping out $40 billion and triggering a massive crypto market crash.

title: Sri Lankan Sovereign Default
description: Sri Lanka defaults on its sovereign debt for the first time in history amid widespread protests and a severe economic crisis.

title: 2022 S&P 500 Bear Market
description: The S&P 500 officially enters a bear market dropping 20% from its peak as global central banks rapidly hike interest rates.

title: Three Arrows Capital (3AC) Collapse
description: Crypto hedge fund 3AC becomes insolvent following the Terra/Luna collapse, causing massive contagion in the crypto sector.

title: UK Gilt Crisis
description: A poorly received UK 'mini-budget' causes a dramatic sell-off in UK government bonds, threatening pension funds and forcing Bank of England intervention.

title: FTX Collapse
description: Cryptocurrency exchange FTX files for bankruptcy amid a massive liquidity crisis and allegations of fraud.

title: Silicon Valley Bank Collapse
description: SVB suffers a catastrophic bank run leading to its collapse, the second-largest in US history, triggering a regional banking panic.

title: Signature Bank Collapse
description: Signature Bank is closed by regulators two days after SVB due to systemic risk exceptions.

title: Credit Suisse Takeover
description: To prevent a systemic banking crisis, the Swiss government engineers a forced takeover of Credit Suisse by UBS.

title: First Republic Bank Failure
description: First Republic is seized by regulators and sold to JPMorgan Chase, becoming the second-largest US bank failure.

title: Pakistan Sovereign Debt Crisis
description: Pakistan avoids a catastrophic sovereign default by securing a last-minute $3 billion IMF bailout.

title: Argentine Peso Devaluation
description: Argentina devalues the peso by over 50% under the new government to combat hyperinflation and stabilize the economy.
